title: Snowed In at Pine Hollow Lodge
_plantedBugs: c7 is never unlocked by any puzzle and is not a start item (unreachable clue)
p3 and p5 both use the answer 1225 (duplicate answer)
s3 Dot Lindqvist has means, motive and opportunity and no alibi (second killer)

solution.how: Victor slipped out the east door at 11:40, cut the sauna heater line, and was back behind the desk by midnight.
solution.why: The victim was about to report Victor's insurance fraud on the lodge.

items.name: Guest Register
items.playerText: Sign-out times for Saturday night. June signed out 10:05 PM, back 10:40 PM. Rev. Pratt: in chapel room all evening (see note). Victor: 'desk' scrawled at 11:30.

items.name: Torn Ski Pass
items.playerText: A ski pass torn in half. The back reads: 'Kitchen staff key — sauna & storage.'

items.name: Kitchen Note
items.playerText: Dot — he said he'd have you fired before the holidays. Watch yourself. — M. Numbers on the back: 4 / 12.

items.name: Victim's Diary
items.playerText: Dec 12: Found the second set of books. Victor's been padding the fire claim. I go to the insurer Monday. Page torn after the 25th.

items.name: Boot Print Photo
items.playerText: Size 11 boot prints in fresh snow from the east door toward the sauna. A wrench-shaped imprint beside them.

items.name: Voicemail

phone.fallback: Dial-in code 4471 on the host sheet

items.playerText: 11:52 PM: 'It's Dot. The east door's banging open again and Victor's coat is soaked. Call me back.'

items.name: Letter in the Fireplace Ashes
items.playerText: Half-burned: '...if the claim goes through we're clear. Burn this. — V.'

items.name: Weather Station Log
items.playerText: Wind gust 11:41 PM triggered the east door alarm. Alarm reset from the front desk at 11:58 PM.

items.name: Snowmobile Keys
items.playerText: A key ring tagged 'SLED 2'. The odometer note says nobody's run it since Thursday.

items.name: Chapel Room Sign-In
items.playerText: Evening prayer circle: Rev. Pratt and two guests, 10 PM to 1 AM.

puzzles.name: Register Lock

text.rookie: Take the first letter of each sign-out name in the order they signed out. That 4-letter word opens the diary envelope.
text.detective: The register hides a word. Order matters.
text.mastermind: Someone signed the book in a pattern. Find the word the lodge never runs out of.

hints: Look only at the sign-out column.
Order the names by sign-out time.
S-N-O-W: the first letters spell SNOW.

puzzles.name: Kitchen Padlock

text.rookie: The kitchen note has two numbers on the back. Put them together as a 4-digit code.
text.detective: The storage padlock takes four digits. The cook's note knows them.
text.mastermind: Four digits. The ski pass says where; the note says what.

hints: 4 and 12 — pad each to two digits.

puzzles.name: Diary Date

text.rookie: The diary is torn after one date. Write that date as MMDD to unlock the phone.
text.detective: The diary stops on a date everyone knows. MMDD.
text.mastermind: Where the diary ends, the phone begins.

hints: The last date mentioned is the 25th of December.

puzzles.name: Boot Direction

text.rookie: Which door did the boot prints come from? Type the direction.
text.detective: Follow the prints back to where they began.
text.mastermind: The snow remembers the way out.

hints: Read the caption on the photo.
The prints start at a door.

puzzles.name: Voicemail Timestamp

text.rookie: Listen to the voicemail. The safe code is the date it was left, MMDD.
text.detective: The safe wants the date of the call.
text.mastermind: When was the call? Not the time. The day.

hints: The voicemail was left the same night as the diary's last entry.

puzzles.name: Put It Together

text.rookie: Who had a reason, a way, and a chance? Type their first name.
text.mastermind: Name the killer and be ready to say how.

hints: Who wanted the diary kept quiet?

final.text: Open the final envelope and make your accusation: who did it?

legend.text: Bonus: the lodge has a ghost story. Find its name.
